hardware.variant: One provisioned development board running the R4 LittleFS profile.

inputs.name: Qt Declarative reference scenes and independent Qt Quick pixel comparison

scenario: Execute the compiled scenes on RV32 and compute CRC32/ISO-HDLC over every pixel, in row-major little-endian RGB565 order. Compare with the independent Qt Quick host output. Present visualparent2 on the physical panel through wsdisplay.
expected: For all three unchanged QML sources the board checksum matches the Qt reference. Nested rectangles extend past their parent and sibling subtrees retain their stacking order.
observed: The board produced 91908b04 for visualparent.qml (320 x 480), 68a77208 for visualparent2.qml (320 x 480), and a14dd879 for grid-spacing.qml (112 x 112). Each CRC matched the complete Qt reference frame. The host renderer also matched the Qt frame byte for byte. A separate display process presented visualparent2 centered at x=80 on the 480 x 480 panel.
limits: Each result covers the named fixture and the specified kit. Only visualparent2 was presented to the panel.
The interactive mousearea.qml case is a host compiler diagnostic test. These three targets do not exercise pointer events or animation.
